reviews.text: Love Dr Kathryn Wexler, she is so nice and patient and competent. And all the stuff them really love pets! You will feel so assured to hand your pet to them.

This is an amazing Vet. They treated me and my puppy with so much care! Dr. Cheung is incredible and always caring and available. They are on top of things, super clean and truly have been a life changing experience with vets!! If you’re thinking of getting a dog, changing vet or are not happy, here is a no brainer.
Dr. Jesse Tong is a kind and  thoughtful vet. He and the staff conduct gentle exams and have a cost conscious approach. Highly recommend.

I can’t say enough good things about Pure Paws Hell’s Kitchen. Everyone we’ve interacted with has been incredibly kind, patient, and compassionate, and they always take the time to answer all of our questions without ever making us feel rushed. They’re also very clear and upfront about pricing, which I really appreciate.

Most importantly, I’ve always felt completely confident trusting them with my fur baby. Dr. Wexler and the team genuinely seem to care about both their patients and their families, and that means so much when you’re putting someone you love in their hands.

They’ve also gone above and beyond for us with things like helping with the paperwork and documentation needed for international travel. From routine care to more complicated situations, we’ve consistently felt supported and well taken care of. I’m so grateful to have found them and would absolutely recommend Pure Paws to anyone looking for a veterinary team that is knowledgeable, compassionate, and truly cares.

It was a great experience from what my brother told me.... they were super friendly and polite and definitely professional.... this was brooklyn first time and we already scheduled a second visit....  very nice place
Compassionate, loving, patient, perceptive, friendly, personal and trust worthy ... Pure Paws is everything you want in a vet.  Go there

My kitten was drooling idk what she ate. I brought her here for answers the vets was nice they gave her meds and now she back to running around being herself again  so thankful for this place will be back
Claire, thank you so much for review! We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!
Great, attentive, knowledgeable, patient caring staff treated my dog with so much love.
So efficient and sweet w my dog!
Alex, thank you! We truly appreciate your support and are glad to have you as part of our Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Hell's Kitchen family.
The entire staff is extremely helpful and very nice. If I ever have a quick question, a vet will always give you a call back as well. I highly recommend pure paws.
I started taking my cats here because it was nearby, but since moving farther away, I go back because everyone - especially Dr. Liff - is so exceptional. Highly recommend this practice.
Love and totally trust Pure Paws with my sweet dog.

I’ve been bringing my dog Jaymo, to this vet since he was just 5 weeks old, and over the years they have truly become a place I trust with his care. They’ve been there for everything from routine visits to some of the more stressful and scary moments, and I’ve always felt like my concerns were taken seriously and that my dog was genuinely cared for.

Most recently, we went through surgery and some health concerns that were extremely nerve-racking for me as a dog mom. The staff was patient with all of my questions, kept me informed, and made sure I understood what was happening and what to expect. Knowing that the people treating him have known and cared for him for so many years made such a difference.

After all these years, I’m incredibly grateful to have a veterinary team that I can trust with someone who means so much to me. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for a vet who is knowledgeable, compassionate, and truly cares about their patients.

Headline: “The Best of the Best”. If you live in the five boroughs or anywhere in the city, this is THE place to take your beloved companions. From dealing with choking emergencies to severe viruses, the vets and staff are beyond compare. Compassion, attentiveness, professionalism, and competence are the standard of care here.

Dr. Liff and her team are absolutely amazing with our dog, Wink. Wink’s a nervous girl and not a fan of going to the vet but the team always goes out of their way to welcome her and make her comfortable. We’ve gone through lots of complex treatments and several surgeries over the 11 years we’ve had her and I always feel like Dr. Liff cares for our dog as if she were her own.  The team is great at squeezing us in on short notice when we need it and they always follow up to check on her after a visit. Couldn’t ask for more!

I love Dr Liff and I think she is very experienced and seasoned and that makes me feel really good about taking my babies to her.  I am a firm believer in homeopathic solves when available and Dr Liff didn’t make me feel foolish but yet was able to suggest something that fit the bill.  Everyone was very welcoming and warm in her office as well.
Dr Liff is the most trusted doctor. she is kind, attentive always there.

Patricia, we’re so glad to know you had a wonderful experience at Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Hell's Kitchen! Our team is dedicated to giving every pet the best care possible, and it means a lot to see that reflected in your review. Thank you for your support!

Dr. Wexler and Pure Paws are truly the best!  Dr. Wexler is thoughtful, attentive, caring and full of love and warmth. The team at Pure Paws is equally invested in each pet's care. We are beyond lucky to have found them and our pets have had the greatest care ever since.

Been in Hells Kitchen for 4 years now and Pure Paws is still my vet of choice.  I have had appointments with about all the vets and everyone is great.  Dr. Wexler and Dr. Liff are two of the best people.  They are always so caring and kind.  Really appreciate all the staff.

Previous review: I’ve been to Pure Paws a few times now and really can’t say enough about them!  The staff is always kind and helpful.  They are always so good to my fur babies.  They are quick but thorough and ready to answer any questions.

Great service great nurses
So lucky to be such a convenient location
Hello Yolande, Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
They are genuinely concerned about the well-being of your pet.
Hi Idaliza, Thank you for the positive review! Our team sincerely appreciates it!
Hello Linda, your support means a lot — thank you for the positive review!
Hello Ornette, thank you for the positive review — we’re glad to have your support!
This practice is great. Dr. Liff and all the staff are professional and kind to my beloved pup.
Had an emergency visit at 7am.  The staff was amazing, as always.  Great care and consideration of both my dog and myself

We were visiting from out of state when our dog came down with an ear infection. The wonderful desk staff got us a same-day appointment and made it incredibly easy. Both the veterinarian and the vet tech were kind, gentle and informative throughout our visit. The knowledgeable and compassionate staff made what could have been a stressful situation into a quick blip on our vacation, and got my pup back to herself quickly! I would absolutely recommend this practice to anyone.

Queenie is an indeed a Queen!
She really loved the doctors and staff!
We were very happy with Queenie’s care for her surgery!
Clean building, friendly and knowledgeable staff!

The best, most well-intentioned vets I’ve been to in the U.S. Everyone was so kind, compassionate, and affectionate with my little Loki, and they took such wonderful care of him. I also really appreciated how transparent and fair they were with pricing. They don’t try to upcharge you or make you feel like you’re being sold unnecessary treatments. It was such a refreshing experience compared to other vets I’ve been to. I couldn’t recommend them more!

Since adopting our dog over a year ago, we have entrusted his care to Pure Paws Vet and have been extremely satisfied! The staff is amazing, from the reception to each nurse and vet, everyone is friendly and welcoming. My dog gets really nervous and hyper when he steps foot into the place, but the staff always takes their time to make him comfortable and make the visit quick and easy for both him and I. I also have never felt like they take advantage of emergencies and price gouge. My dog has always received top notch care for reasonable prices, which allows me to provide him with what he needs. They also go out of their way to call and check-in on your pet after every visit, which makes this vet feel like more than just a transaction. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND 😊

As a first-time pet owner, choosing a veterinarian felt like a huge decision, and I couldn’t be happier that I chose Pure Paws.

Even before I brought my kitten, Ilya, home, the person I spoke to on the phone when I was fact finding was incredibly warm, patient and knowledgeable. She took the time to answer all of my questions and explain everything, which immediately put me at ease and made me feel confident that I had found the right practice.

When I needed to move my appointment, it was handled quickly and without any difficulty. From the moment I arrived, the reception team were so welcoming, friendly and helpful.

The clinic itself was spotless, and I appreciated the little touches that showed how much they care. Before examining Ilya, they placed a clean towel on the examination table so he wasn’t lying directly on the surface, which I thought was such a thoughtful detail.

Dr Wexler, the veterinarian, was absolutely wonderful. She carried out a very thorough examination and explained every check she was performing and why she was doing it. As a brand-new pet owner, that meant so much. I never once felt rushed or made to feel silly for worrying about what thankfully turned out not to be a serious eye issue. Instead, I felt listened to, reassured and genuinely cared for.

The veterinary assistants were equally amazing. They weighed Ilya, took his temperature and handled him so gently, giving him cuddles, kisses and talking to him throughout the appointment. They made sure he felt relaxed, and seeing how lovingly they treated him immediately put me at ease too.

They also explained all of the costs before anything was done, so there were no surprises, which I really appreciated.

Dr Wexler even showed me exactly how to apply Ilya’s eye drops at home. I was able to do it confidently because she took the time to demonstrate it properly, and that made a huge difference as a first-time owner.

The thing that impressed me most was receiving a follow-up phone call the very next day to check how Ilya was doing and whether I had managed to get his eye drops. That level of care genuinely exceeded my expectations.

Throughout the entire experience, every member of the team made me feel like I was their only client. Although I know they have busy days, I never felt hurried or like I was taking up too much of their time. They answered every question with kindness and patience, and I left feeling informed, supported and confident about caring for my kitten.

I am so pleased I chose Pure Paws. They have made what could have been a very daunting experience into such a positive one, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone—especially first-time pet owners.

Our dog has been a patient of Pure Paws for nine years. We have always received the most professional and attentive service from doctors, technicians, and admin staff. I thoroughly recommend the practice.

Pure Paws is my 'Go To" Veterinarian. So caring for both pets and their owners. They tended to both my cat's health issues and my concerns. Followup was good.
A+

Today, around 1:00 p.m., I called your office to express my dissatisfaction with my last appointment, which was not inexpensive.

The veterinarian who saw Negroni seemed rushed throughout the entire consultation. I came specifically because I was concerned about my dog’s weight, wanted to change his diet, and improve his overall routine. At no point did anyone proactively tell me that my dog was overweight or that his target weight should be 43 kg. I had to ask.

When she cleaned his ear, she inserted a cotton swab without first looking inside his ear with the otoscope. The following day, my dog was in obvious discomfort when I applied his ear medication. This has never happened before, even during much more severe ear infections. It felt like she was in such a hurry that she was poking inside his ear without properly examining it first.

When I explained that I did not want the food she recommended, she seemed unhappy with my decision. I would understand that reaction if she had taken the initiative to discuss nutrition from the beginning, but she only addressed it after I brought it up.

She also pointed out some redness and asked, “Did you notice this is red?” When I got home and examined Negroni carefully, I found that he was covered in irritated skin, and his elbow was raw. At no point during the consultation did she thoroughly examine his allergies. His ears are affected, his skin is affected, and he is clearly having an allergic flare-up. This is not simply because of the food, since he had eaten this same food before without these problems.

Today I called because my dog does not even want to get up. He had already been vomiting for about a week, had loose stools for about a week, and I had already informed the clinic about all of these symptoms. Despite that, your staff kept insisting on doing a consultation over the phone.

I was clearly upset because I am worried about my dog, yet I kept hearing, “We’re trying to help you.” What part of “my dog needs to be examined” was unclear? He is not a case that should be managed over the phone.

I requested an appointment this same week after having already paid for a recent consultation, but no one was willing to see him. Now I am being told to take him to an emergency hospital within 24 hours. Is that really fair after everything I have already paid at your clinic?

I specifically requested to see the Japanese veterinarian because the last time she treated Negroni, she was attentive, thorough, and never made me feel like she was rushing through the appointment.

I have been a loyal client of this clinic for a long time, and every single visit represents a significant expense. I expected to be treated with much more care and respect than I received today.

Please reply with exactly what you told me over the phone: that the owner of the practice will be back on Tuesday and will contact me then.

Until Tuesday, my dog will be left without assistance.
Hello Tatiana, your support means a lot — thank you for the positive review!

Dental Care
Pure Paws Veternary Care Took fabulous care of my baby Star 7lb  Yorkie when she had to have all her teeth removed in surgery.
Everyone there was pleasant and we had a great experience. I appreciated that Dr. Liff walked us through our bill before we had any services. I felt the care of our cat was in great hands!

Had a great experience with Pure Paws. Went here to get an international travel certificate for my cat. Vet was very knowledgeable of requirements, everyone in the clinic was friendly and nice to my cat, and they were absolutely on top of the process and kept me in the loop as we waited for the document to be endorsed. Can definitely recommend!
Wonderful practice with very knowledgeable and attentive veterinarians and staff.

The front desk and techs are SO sweet. Unfortunately the pricing is very vague and made me feel rushed and taken advantage of financially. I never felt like I was worked with, only at. Items got put on my bill I didn’t need at all, others that cost $100 from them but $25 from Chewy which was never said to me until I found it on my own, and other items that were over $100 but found for $60 at CVS. They tried to charge me nearly $1,000 for my first visit, including the adopted dog discount. Second visit (three weeks later) $600. We have switched to another vet who we are beyond lucky to have been recommended. She sat on the floor with my dog for an hour and checked every inch of her, looked at her ear swabs under a microscope, prescribed her what she needed, and the entire thing cost $290. My dog immediately fell asleep she felt so calm in her office.

Dr. Liff has been my dog’s vet since he was 9weeks old, he’s 8 years old now. I trust her wholeheartedly and it is a plus that she’s super nice to my dog and me. The staff is always friendly and professional.
Hello Azurewolf, thank you for the positive review — we’re glad to have your support!
Dr Liff has been incredible with Hank and keeping us updated and informed.  We are so grateful for her.  The staff at the Hell’s Kitchen pure paws was also wonderful to Hank and to us.
Excellent, on time, kind and helpful, good humored and pleasant.  Excelent.

Best vet I been to, as soon as I walked in it was a clean and safe environment for my pet haze. A warm welcoming greeting for me and her. They took great care with tending to haze, making her feel safe. One of the best thing is they work with your budget if you have one. Very recommended!!!

I can no longer recommend this clinic after my experience with my puppy.

I brought her in because something was clearly wrong. She was monitored for several hours, but the staff could not determine the cause of her condition. Rather than escalating the situation or providing answers, I received a call asking me to come pick her up. When I was unable to do so, she was transferred to an emergency hospital.

At the ER, doctors quickly discovered a bone lodged internally that had been causing the issue. Her condition became so critical that she briefly died before the emergency team was able to revive her and save her life.

To make matters worse, on a separate visit for grooming and a nail trim, unauthorized services were performed and I was presented with a bill of nearly $900.

The lack of urgency surrounding my puppy’s medical emergency and the unauthorized charges left me with no confidence in this practice.
Travis, thank you! We truly appreciate your support and are glad to have you as part of our Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Hell's Kitchen family.
Always a positive experience at Pure Paws. I would not entrust my dog to anyone else.

Erick, we’re so glad to know you had a wonderful experience at Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Hell's Kitchen! Our team is dedicated to giving every pet the best care possible, and it means a lot to see that reflected in your review. Thank you for your support!
Wonderful staff who provide exceptional care .
very friendly staff and great care for our dig. Highly recommended vet!
Dr. Liff & her team are the best! So kind & caring. I’ve been taking my dog Luna here for a few years now & always a positive experience !

Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Hell's Kitchen—and Dr. Katie Wexler in particular—did amazing by my young rescue pup, both regarding her healthcare needs and paperwork for international travel. 100% recommend, I’d absolutely choose them again!

We’ve been going to Pure Paws seeing Dr. Cheung, Dr. Liff, and the entire team for a while now, and they have been an absolute lifesaver. Max has a complicated medical situation, but they are always there to help us navigate it. Their compassionate care has helped reduce the stress of managing his health. We couldn't ask for a better team to trust with our dog.

I have to 100% agree with all positive comments left regarding this location.  My fur baby has had some repeated issues related to his ear and general health.  Pure Paws takes such good care to ensure that your loved ones are getting not only the most holistic care on the day of your visit but also considering all previous visits.
They take the time to ensure you understand both short and long term care.  Having to return to the vet a few times, I was stressed about the health of my dog, but I have always been comfortable to raise any concern with the team, and it always feels like their answers go beyond 'general care' to actually considering what makes sense for my dog's particular age, environment, breed, etc.
I also really appreciate their transparency of fees, easy appointment scheduling, and convenient billing.
They are the best. Super professional and always helpful.
Hello Lea, Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

The BEST vet ever, Dr. Liff is SO involved in my cat’s care and she has worked tirelessly to make sure we know what’s going on with him and that he feels happy and comfortable! They are always so gentle, sweet, and caring with him and I know he’s getting the best care possible. I love this place so much I still travel to it, even after moving 30 blocks north.
Staff and office environment is welcoming. Have always given my dog the best treated available.
Kind and caring
Very nice clean and caring.  I feel like Peluche is in good hands and in the right place.
To a person , the staff is compassionate, knowledgeable and helpful .
Thank you for the five-star rating! We're glad you had a great experience with us. What did you enjoy most about your visit to our Hell's Kitchen practice?
They take such loving care of our two cats, and I cannot begin to express my gratitude at their professionalism and their delicate touch.

The entire team at Pure Paws has been absolutely fantastic to my sometimes difficult but sweet pup. She has seen ALL of the DVMs there( Liff, Slome, Gibeon and Cheung) and was always treated with top tier care, compassion and love. Our regular vet is Dr. Slome, who we have been seeing regularly and I LOVE her. She was a tremendous help in aiding us in figuring out what has been going on with my dog. Now that we figured out the diagnosis, Skoochie on the road to a happy, healthy life. So thank you, Dr. Slome. I trust all of the people from Pure Paws, from their front desk staff to the doctors and couldn't imagine bringing Skoochie anywhere outside of Pure Paws. You guys rock!
